pairs.subject: app-shell
pairs.evidence: src/components/org/shell/OrgTabChunks.tsx:28 The overview panel (and PersonalOverview with its client AddRepoForm draft at PersonalWatchControls.tsx:29) is wrapped in a per-tab keyed div, so every return to the tab remounts the subtree, replays the fade-in entrance and discards local form state, which is the cold-load choreography on warm return that lazy-section-loading forbids (the comment on lines 26-27 records the trade but does not discharge it; the earlier citation of line 55 is stale, the file is now 33 lines).

techniques.evidence: src/components/org/shell/OrgTabChunks.tsx:28 Re-keying the whole section per location throws away warm return to get an entrance animation. There is no restore or keep-alive path for panel-local state like the AddRepoForm draft (useState at PersonalWatchControls.tsx:29). The error boundary already resets on resetKey={tab}, so the remount is not needed to contain crashes.

src/app/org/page.tsx:13 Bare /org restores the last location (the remembered org cookie). resolveViewerWorkspace checks it against canReadOrg and falls back to the public org, and the server redirect replaces history instead of pushing a new entry.

pairs.subject: app-shell
pairs.evidence: src/app/layout.tsx:72 The root layout hosts the single app-wide dialog host as a sibling of {children}, above the swap point. Unknown addresses land on a branded 404 that reuses the shared nav link list. Route failures render a stated failure with a retry. The org-demo link is gated by the same isDbConfigured check the header uses.

techniques.evidence: src/app/layout.tsx:72 One global surface is mounted at the layer root beside children, never inside the part rebuilt per route, so dialogs outlive navigation. The repo has no second ModalRoot mount.

src/app/not-found.tsx:19 An unrecognized address falls back to a defined surface with links back into the product. Its nav reads the same link list as SiteHeader, so there is one vocabulary instead of a hand-copied one.

src/app/error.tsx:21 A failure is stated with a retry, never left blank. RouteError calls router.refresh() before reset(), and global-error falls back to a hard reload, which is the refresh cure for version skew.

src/app/not-found.tsx:58 The org-demo entry is hidden on DB-less deployments, where the feature does not apply, using the same isDbConfigured authority as the header. The /org destination itself explains the missing DB instead of rendering blank.
